passages.text: “So Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person are to carry out everything commanded by the LORD, who has given them skill and ability to know how to perform all the work of constructing the sanctuary.”
passages.sermon:
Bezalel was a skilled craftsman.
Oholiab was also a skilled craftsman.
The LORD gave wisdom and understanding to Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person.
The LORD gave them the ability to know how to do the work.
They knew how to perform all the work for the holy place.
They were to do everything the LORD commanded.
They were to carry out all the work for the sanctuary.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂה֩ בְצַלְאֵ֨ל וְאָהֳלִיאָ֜ב וְכֹ֣ל׀ אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־ לֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּתְבוּנָה֙ בָּהֵ֔מָּה לָדַ֣עַת לַעֲשֹׂ֔ת אֶֽת־ כָּל־ מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Moses summoned Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person whom the LORD had gifted—everyone whose heart stirred him to come and do the work.
passages.sermon:
Moses called Bezalel.
Moses called Oholiab.
Moses called every skilled person.
The LORD had given these people wisdom in their hearts.
Each person felt a desire in his heart to come.
Each person wanted to do the work.
Moses called all of them to do the work.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶל־ בְּצַלְאֵ֘ל וְאֶל־ אָֽהֳלִיאָב֒ וְאֶל֙ כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־ לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה חָכְמָ֖ה בְּלִבּ֑וֹ כֹּ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר נְשָׂא֣וֹ לִבּ֔וֹ לְקָרְבָ֥ה אֶל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: They received from Moses all the contributions that the Israelites had brought to carry out the service of constructing the sanctuary. Meanwhile, the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning, so that all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work and said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD has commanded us to do.”
passages.sermon:
The skilled craftsmen received all the contributions from Moses.
The Israelites had brought these gifts for the work of building the sanctuary.
The people kept bringing freewill offerings every morning.
All the skilled craftsmen were working on the sanctuary.
Each craftsman left his work and came to Moses.
They said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for the work.”
The LORD has commanded us to do this work.
passages.original: וַיִּקְח֞וּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַתְּרוּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִמְלֶ֛אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַעֲשֹׂ֣ת אֹתָ֑הּ וְ֠הֵם הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֵלָ֥יו ע֛וֹד נְדָבָ֖ה בַּבֹּ֥קֶר בַּבֹּֽקֶר׃ וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ כָּל־ הַ֣חֲכָמִ֔ים הָעֹשִׂ֕ים אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אִֽישׁ־ אִ֥ישׁ מִמְּלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים׃ וַיֹּאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה לֵּאמֹ֔ר מַרְבִּ֥ים הָעָ֖ם לְהָבִ֑יא מִדֵּ֤י הָֽעֲבֹדָה֙ לַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: After Moses had given an order, they sent a proclamation throughout the camp: “No man or woman should make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing more, since what they already had was more than enough to perform all the work.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses gave an order to the people.
Messengers spread a message through the camp.
The message said, “No man or woman should make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.”
The people stopped bringing offerings.
The people already brought enough for all the work.
There was even more than what was needed.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אַל־ יַעֲשׂוּ־ ע֛וֹד מְלָאכָ֖ה לִתְרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַיִּכָּלֵ֥א הָעָ֖ם מֵהָבִֽיא׃ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַיָּ֛ם לְכָל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֹתָ֑הּ וְהוֹתֵֽר׃ס

passages.text: All the skilled craftsmen among the workmen made the ten curtains for the tabernacle. They were made of finely spun linen, as well as blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
passages.sermon:
Skilled craftsmen worked on the tabernacle.
These craftsmen had wise and understanding hearts.
They made ten curtains for the tabernacle.
They used finely spun linen to make the curtains.
They also used blue yarn.
They used purple yarn.
They used scarlet yarn.
They skillfully wove cherubim into the curtains.
They made the cherubim with great skill.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ כָל־ חֲכַם־ לֵ֜ב בְּעֹשֵׂ֧י הַמְּלָאכָ֛ה אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide; all the curtains were the same size.
passages.sermon: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long.\r\nEach curtain was four cubits wide.\r\nAll the curtains had the same size.
passages.original: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְכָל־ הַיְרִיעֹֽת׃

passages.text: And he joined five of the curtains together, and the other five he joined as well.
passages.sermon:
The skilled craftsmen worked on the tabernacle.
They made ten curtains for the tabernacle.
He joined five curtains together to make one set.
He joined the other five curtains together to make a second set.
passages.original: וַיְחַבֵּר֙ אֶת־ חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־ אֶחָ֑ת וְחָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חִבַּ֔ר אַחַ֖ת אֶל־ אֶחָֽת׃

passages.text: He made loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and also on the end curtain in the second set.
passages.sermon:
He made loops from blue material.
He put these loops on the edge of the end curtain in the first set.
He also made loops on the edge of the end curtain in the second set.
He placed these loops at the place where the curtains would be joined.
passages.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת מִקָּצָ֖ה בַּמַּחְבָּ֑רֶת כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ בִּשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּמַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: He made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops lined up opposite one another.
passages.sermon:
A man made the curtains for the tabernacle.
He made fifty loops on one curtain.
He made fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set.
The loops on both curtains matched each other.
Each loop lined up directly with its opposite loop.
passages.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֮ בַּיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָת֒ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַיְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּמַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־ אֶחָֽת׃

passages.text: He also made fifty gold clasps to join the curtains together, so that the tabernacle was a unit.
passages.sermon:
Moses built the tabernacle for God.
He made fifty clasps.
He used gold to make the clasps.
He joined the curtains together with the clasps.
The curtains became one unit.
The tabernacle became one whole structure.
passages.original: וַיַּ֕עַשׂ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וַיְחַבֵּ֨ר אֶת־ הַיְרִעֹ֜ת אַחַ֤ת אֶל־ אַחַת֙ בַּקְּרָסִ֔ים וַֽיְהִ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃ס

passages.text: He then made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
passages.sermon: A man made curtains for the tent over the tabernacle.\r\nHe used goat hair to make these curtains.\r\nHe made eleven curtains in total.
passages.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְאֹ֖הֶל עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Each of the eleven curtains was the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
Each curtain was the same size.
There were eleven curtains.
Each curtain was thirty cubits long.
Each curtain was four cubits wide.
passages.original: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת רֹ֖חַב הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְעַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת׃

passages.text: He joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another.
passages.sermon: He joined five curtains together to make one set.\r\nHe joined six curtains together to make another set.
passages.original: וַיְחַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ חֲמֵ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וְאֶת־ שֵׁ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָֽד׃

passages.text: He made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
passages.sermon:
A man made the tabernacle.
He made two sets of curtains for the tent.
Each set had several curtains joined together.
He made fifty loops on the edge of the last curtain in the first set.
He made fifty loops on the edge of the last curtain in the second set.
He placed the loops along the edges where the two sets would meet.
passages.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלָאֹ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֗ים עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּמַּחְבָּ֑רֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ עַל־ שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַחֹבֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: He also made fifty bronze clasps to join the tent together as a unit.
passages.sermon:
He made fifty clasps.
He used bronze to make the clasps.
He made the clasps to join the tent.
The clasps joined the tent into one unit.
passages.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים לְחַבֵּ֥ר אֶת־ הָאֹ֖הֶל לִֽהְיֹ֥ת אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Additionally, he made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
passages.sermon:
He made a covering for the tent.
He used ram skins dyed red for this covering.
He also made another covering to go above it.
He used fine leather for the top covering.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ מִכְסֶה֙ לָאֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵלִ֖ים מְאָדָּמִ֑ים וּמִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃ס

passages.text: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
passages.sermon: He made the frames for the tabernacle.\r\nHe used acacia wood.\r\nHe made the frames stand upright.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים׃

passages.text: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
passages.sermon:
Each frame was a part of the tabernacle.
Each frame was ten cubits long.
Each frame was one and a half cubits wide.
passages.original: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמֹּ֖ות אֹ֣רֶךְ הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ וְאַמָּה֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Two tenons were connected to each other for each frame. He made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
passages.sermon: Each frame had two tenons.\r\nThe two tenons fit together.\r\nHe made every frame of the tabernacle this way.
passages.original: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדֹ֗ת לַקֶּ֙רֶשׁ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁלָּבֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־ אֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: He constructed twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle, with forty silver bases to put under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
passages.sermon:
Moses built the tabernacle.
He made twenty frames for the south side.
He made forty silver bases for these frames.
He placed two bases under each frame.
Each base supported one tenon of the frame.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קְרָשִׁ֔ים לִפְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גֶב תֵּימָֽנָה׃ וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי־ כֶ֔סֶף עָשָׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת־ הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת־ הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, he made twenty frames and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle was a holy tent for God’s presence.
The north side was the second side of the tabernacle.
He made twenty frames for the north side.
He made forty silver bases for these frames.
He put two silver bases under each frame.
passages.original: וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עָשָׂ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים קְרָשִֽׁים׃ וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: He made six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side, and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle, coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. He made both corners in this way.
passages.sermon:
Moses built the tabernacle as God commanded.
He made six frames for the rear of the tabernacle.
The rear side was the west side.
He made two more frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle.
He joined the corner frames together from bottom to top.
He fitted the corner frames into a single ring at the top.
He made both corners in the same way.
passages.original: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה עָשָׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים׃ וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃ וְהָי֣וּ תוֹאֲמִם֮ מִלְּמַטָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ אֶל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־ הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן עָשָׂ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֖י הַמִּקְצֹעֹֽת׃

passages.text: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle had a rear side.
The rear side had eight frames.
There were sixteen silver bases.
Each frame had two silver bases under it.
passages.original: וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֤י אֲדָנִים֙ שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: He also made five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle, five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
passages.sermon:
Moses built the tabernacle as God commanded.
He made crossbars for the tabernacle.
He used acacia wood for the crossbars.
He made five crossbars for the frames on one side of the tabernacle.
He made five crossbars for the frames on the other side of the tabernacle.
He made five crossbars for the frames at the rear of the tabernacle.
The rear side of the tabernacle faced west.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּרִיחֵ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽת׃ וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה בְרִיחִם֙ לְקַרְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה׃

passages.text: He made the central crossbar to run through the center of the frames, from one end to the other.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel made the central crossbar.
He made it for the tabernacle.
He placed the central crossbar inside the frames.
The central crossbar ran from one end of the frames to the other end.
It passed through the center of all the frames.
passages.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ הַבְּרִ֣יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֑ן לִבְרֹ֙חַ֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֔ים מִן־ הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל־ הַקָּצֶֽה׃

passages.text: And he overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. He also overlaid the crossbars with gold.
passages.sermon:
He overlaid the frames with gold.
He made gold rings for the frames.
The gold rings held the crossbars.
He overlaid the crossbars with gold.
passages.original: וְֽאֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־ טַבְּעֹתָם֙ עָשָׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וַיְצַ֥ף אֶת־ הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: Next, he made the veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
passages.sermon:
A man named Bezalel made the veil.
He used blue yarn.
He used purple yarn.
He used scarlet yarn.
He used finely spun linen.
He made the veil with great skill.
He worked cherubim into the veil.
passages.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ אֶת־ הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃

passages.text: He also made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold, along with gold hooks; and he cast four silver bases for the posts.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel made four posts.
He used acacia wood for the posts.
He overlaid the posts with gold.
He made hooks for the posts.
He made the hooks out of gold.
He cast four bases for the posts.
He made the bases out of silver.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לָ֗הּ אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַיְצַפֵּ֣ם זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וַיִּצֹ֣ק לָהֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי־ כָֽסֶף׃

passages.text: For the entrance to the tent, he made a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, together with five posts and their hooks. He overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold, and their five bases were bronze.
passages.sermon:
A man made a curtain for the entrance to the tent.
He used blue yarn, purple yarn, and scarlet yarn.
He also used finely spun linen.
He embroidered the curtain.
He made five posts for the curtain.
He made hooks for the posts.
He covered the tops of the posts with gold.
He covered the bands of the posts with gold.
He made five bases for the posts.
He made the bases from bronze.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם׃ וְאֶת־ עַמּוּדָ֤יו חֲמִשָּׁה֙ וְאֶת־ וָ֣וֵיהֶ֔ם וְצִפָּ֧ה רָאשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ
